en: Colorized view of a European riverside city with a metal bridge crossing a turquoise river, lined with 19th‑century buildings and a church tower with a green onion dome and clock. Above the city rises a steep, wooded hill crowned by fortress walls and buildings; on the right side of the hill stands a distinctive clock tower. Printed in red at the top left is the caption 'Graz‑Mur‑Schlossberg'. A commercial sign on a riverside building reads 'JOS SOBEL'. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century tourist postcard.
